Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

birthday — the day you were born. Example: My birthday is on Saturday.
party — a social event with friends. Example: I would like to have a party.
gift — something you give to someone. Example: I have got a gift for you.
cake — a sweet baked food for celebrations. Example: There is a big cake.
card — a folded paper with a message. Example: I write a birthday card.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Would you like to come to my party?
• I'd love to.
• My birthday is on ...
• I have got a gift for you.
• Happy birthday!

Grammar focus: Would like to + verb for invitations.
Use would like to + verb for invitations: Would you like to come to my party? I would like to invite you. Use on with days: on Saturday.
